caption:
Quick tip before you build on Wix or another AI website builder: Wix says your site must run on Wix's servers, so if your business outgrows it, the next step is usually a rebuild, not a move. Your domain name is the part you can take with you.

More on choosing the right path: https://brightboxdigital.io/blog/ai-website-builder-vs-professional-website-development/?utm_source=google&utm_medium=organic&utm_campaign=gbp_blog&utm_content=ai-website-builder-vs-professional-website-development-followup
